name: browser/switch-tab
description: Bring an open tab to the front by clicking it in the tab strip.

steps.note: MEASURED: Chrome's tab strip items are UIA tabs named by title ('Migros', 'WhatsApp') at y=0-82. nth 1 in reading order is the strip, above any tabs the PAGE draws (Migros's own 'Migros Ekstra Ürünleri!' tabs also contain the word). v1 used ctrl+shift+a tab search: the popup filtered but enter did not switch, and a click inside it did not register.
The window title is the active tab's, so this PROVES the switch.
